hooks.notes: Balance (game/scripts/balance-probe.mts): was +10. Waking at home softens the day (+3 against the dawn's -4.4), it no longer refills you on its own, so staying in the den doing nothing still runs the fire down.
felt: You woke by your own hearth. That steadies something.
Your own fire, your own stones. You wake a little more whole.

hooks.notes: Balance (game/scripts/balance-probe.mts): was +12, then -6, now -4.4. Each dawn asks something of you: with only the archetype's own small comfort (+3) idle play loses about 1.4 a day and an heirless idle life burns out in six to seven weeks (probe, 4 seeds: Marrow day 39-53, Ivy 47-63, the Brood 38-49; at -6 it was day 20-26, about three weeks, too quick to learn the world in). Bren has no unconditional comfort and still burns out idle in two weeks (was 10-11 days). Spark comes back from real deeds (seeing people grow, working beside them, carrying, holding to work), not from sleeping; the wild's daily cap (contrib/thing-verbs PROP_SPARK_PER_DAY) stays under the dawn's net cost, so lingering alone only slows the fall.
felt: You wake, and the morning takes its small cut of your fire, as it always does.
Your fire is a little lower at dawn. Each morning asks a little of you.

hooks.notes: Balance (game/scripts/balance-probe.mts): was +10. A clean ledger is a comfort (+3), not a refill, so idle play stays net-negative.
felt: You told no lie yesterday. Your ink sits clean, and so do you.
You wake light. Nothing false written yesterday.

hooks.notes: Balance (game/scripts/balance-probe.mts): was +6. This is where kind play earns its spark back: at +3 four kind deeds a day hold the fire (mean ~83, rarely burns out); at +6 kindness paid more than it cost and spark never moved off full; at +2 kind play burned out within 20-90 days.
felt: You saw someone grow for real. It lit you too.
You watched them come back to themselves, and it warmed you more than you expected.

hooks.notes: Balance (game/scripts/balance-probe.mts): was +12. Basking together is a comfort (+3), not a refill, so idle play stays net-negative.
felt: You all slept under one roof. The brood basks together this morning.
Your bodies lay in one town last night. You wake as one warm heap.

hooks.notes: Worked beside someone yesterday: the row was full again for a shift. Balance (game/scripts/balance-probe.mts): was +8; +6 outweighs the dawn (-4.4) and the empty row (-1), so a Bren who works alongside holds steady.
felt: You worked alongside someone yesterday. Shared bread tastes of it this morning.
Your hands remember yesterday's work beside someone. It still sits warm in you.
